title: Conditional Reality
definition: The understanding that all aspects of existence, including our identities and experiences, are the result of specific conditions.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think about it like a recipe. Everything in life happens because certain things are just right. It's not magic, it's just the way things are.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Conditional reality is a philosophical concept that emphasizes the dependence of all things on specific conditions. This understanding is fundamental to many Eastern philosophies and the principle of Dependent Origination in Buddhism.
difficulty_levels.expert: Conditional reality challenges the notion of a self-subsistent, permanent self. It highlights the interconnectedness of all things and the role of conditions in shaping reality. This concept connects to the field of complexity science and the study of emergent phenomena, where the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.

extra_fields.insight: All aspects of existence are conditional, and our understanding of reality has the power to transform our experiences and perspectives.
